summary: A really important space game that teaches STEM students.Its important because we wont have many space engineers in the future and with this project they will be more educated about this topic. We used lots of NASA sources to do this. We used Unity, C#, Python and Blender to make this project.
details: A space mission game that teaches STEM students.It works by teaching lots of steps.It benefits students by teaching real NASA projects.We will have lots of space engineers with this project.We used blender c# and pyhton.Its creative because we dont have lots of project in the market.We considered lots of details like real NASA resources.
